description: This file defines classes and an abstract grain for testing log consistency providers using Orleans framework, involving state with update operations, and grain methods for manipulating and retrieving state, including event sourcing features.

classes.name: MyGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the grain state with fields A, B, and Reservations, including update methods and a ToString override.

classes.name: UpdateA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update for field A.

classes.name: UpdateB
classes.description: Serializable class representing an update for field B.

classes.name: IncrementA
classes.description: Serializable class representing an increment operation for A.

classes.name: AddReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing an addition to the Reservations dictionary.

classes.name: RemoveReservation
classes.description: Serializable class representing removal from the Reservations dictionary.

classes.name: LogTestGrain
classes.description: Abstract class for a grain used in testing log inclusion and consistency, with properties and methods for updating and retrieving state, using Orleans event sourcing features.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation event, does not wait for initial load.

methods.name: SetAGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global value of A and confirms events.

methods.name: SetAConditional
methods.description: Conditionally sets value of A based on version and returns success status.

methods.name: SetALocal
methods.description: Locally sets value of A.

methods.name: SetBGlobal
methods.description: Sets the global value of B and confirms events.

methods.name: SetBLocal
methods.description: Locally sets value of B.

methods.name: IncrementAGlobal
methods.description: Increments the global value of A and confirms events.

methods.name: IncrementALocal
methods.description: Locally increments value of A.

methods.name: GetAGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves the global value of A after refresh.

methods.name: GetALocal
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative local value of A.

methods.name: GetBothGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves both A and B values after refresh.

methods.name: GetBothLocal
methods.description: Retrieves tentative local values of A and B.

methods.name: AddReservationLocal
methods.description: Adds a reservation locally.

methods.name: RemoveReservationLocal
methods.description: Removes a reservation locally.

methods.name: GetReservationsGlobal
methods.description: Retrieves all reservation values after refresh.

methods.name: SynchronizeGlobalState
methods.description: Refreshes the grain state to synchronize.

methods.name: GetConfirmedVersion
methods.description: Returns the current confirmed version.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the current version and state.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Performs a conditional update given a list of operations and an expected version.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain.

methods.name: GetEventLog
methods.description: Retrieves all confirmed events from the grain.
